2.198.2
RadialScale.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.ActionInfo element specifies the actions for a RadialScale. This element is optional.
This element is of type ActionInfo.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
